title: Coverage Bulletin: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Limits Apply per Vehicle per Loss
content:
**Coverage position.** The limits of Cardinal Rental Reimbursement apply per vehicle per loss. Each damaged vehicle's claim draws on that vehicle's own option. When two vehicles of a household are damaged in one occurrence, each vehicle keeps its own daily limit, per-loss maximum and maximum days. The limits are never pooled and never transferred.

Every payment on a claim draws on the same per-loss maximum and the same maximum days. This holds whether the payment goes to an agency or to the customer, and whether it is for a rental car or for rideshare, taxi or transit. Only one rental (the option's limit on rentals running at once) may run at a time on one claim. A new loss starts a fresh per-loss benefit. The benefit is never annual.

## How "used" is measured on a claim

The window for both measures is one loss of one vehicle, meaning one claim number.

- **Benefit used.** The agency payments plus the reimbursements recorded on the claim number, less the agency credits recorded on it. Subrogation recoveries do not restore the benefit, so they are not deducted.
- **Days used.** The days billed on the agency payments plus the days billed on the reimbursements recorded on the claim number.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200)

| Entry on the claim | Amount | Days billed |
|---|---|---|
| Agency payment | $400.00 | 10 |
| Reimbursement for rideshare fares | $150.00 | 4 |
| Agency credit against the agency payment | $50.00 | — |
| Subrogation recovery from the other insurer | $100.00 | — |

Benefit used is $400.00 plus $150.00, less the $50.00 agency credit, which comes to $500.00. The subrogation recovery is not deducted. Days used are 10 plus 4, which comes to 14. Against the $1200.00 per-loss maximum, $700.00 remains on this claim.

## Points of judgement

- *Two cars damaged in one hailstorm, one carrying 30/900 and one carrying 60/1800.* Each claim is paid under its own vehicle's option. Unused benefit on one vehicle does not move to the other.
- *A second, unrelated loss on the same vehicle later in the term.* The new claim starts with the full per-loss maximum and the full maximum days.
- *Rideshare fares and a rental car on the same claim.* Both draw on the same per-loss maximum and the same maximum days.
